title: Uwell Caliburn G3/GPP Replacement Pod 2mL 4-Pack
description:
The
Uwell Caliburn G3/GPP Replacement Pod 2mL 4-Pack
is the CRC replacement pod for Caliburn G3 series devices. It replaces the original Caliburn G3 pod and uses Uwell’s G Pod Platform (GPP) design with a built-in mesh coil  -  no separate coils to buy.
Product Type:
Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Fill with E-Liquid)
E-Liquid Capacity:
2mL per Pod (CRC)
Pack Contents:
4 Pods
Coil Resistance:
Integrated Mesh  -  0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.9Ω or 1.2Ω
Fill Method:
Top Fill
Compatible Devices:
Caliburn G3, G3 Pro, G3 Lite, GK3, GK3 TENET, G4, G4 Mini
Brand:
Uwell
Coils are built into the pod. E-liquid sold separately.
Available options: 0.4 ohm (2mL), 0.6 ohm (2mL), 0.9 ohm (2mL), 1.2 ohm (2mL).
